test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a cylindrical pillar is 176 m² and its volume is 352 m³. Find the ratio of its radius to its height.{(Use } pi = (22)/(7) {)}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volume (V)** to **Curved Surface Area (CSA)**: V ÷ CSA = (πr²h) ÷ (2πrh) = r ÷ 2.

352 ÷ 176 = r ÷ 2 ⇒ 2 = r ÷ 2 ⇒ **radius (r)** = 4 m.

Substitute r in CSA: 2 × (22/7) × 4 × h = 176 ⇒ (176/7) × h = 176 ⇒ **height (h)** = 7 m.

**Ratio** of radius to height = 4 : 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 4:7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of the pillar = 176 m²

**Volume (V)** of the pillar = 352 m³

Value of π = 22/7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7315848f76ec08d71c346dbb7670c63e03619d91d22095a9f57db20a58df13.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

Volume (V) = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Dividing Volume by CSA: V ÷ CSA = (πr²h) ÷ (2πrh)

⇒ 352 ÷ 176 = r ÷ 2

⇒ 2 = r ÷ 2

⇒ **radius (r)** = 2 × 2 = 4 m

⇒ Now, using CSA formula: 2 × (22/7) × 4 × h = 176

⇒ (176/7) × h = 176

⇒ **height (h)** = 176 × (7/176) = 7 m

⇒ **Ratio** of radius to height (r : h) = 4 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 4:7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

It is the sum of the curved surface area and the areas of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a cone with the same radius and height as a cylinder is exactly one-third of the cylinder's volume: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Relation between V and CSA

For any cylinder, the ratio of its Volume to its Curved Surface Area is always r ÷ 2.</p
